public_instruction: Balance both closed storage cabinets in the north guest bedroom using supplies from the south utility-room counter so each cabinet holds one bottle of water, one bottle of apple juice, and one box of crackers while unused surplus supplies stay on the south utility-room counter and both cabinet doors end closed; shelve both paperback books from the hallway workbench onto the study-doorway wall shelf, unlock the closed hallway metal toolbox (which must not be opened while either book is still on the workbench or toolbox) to install light bulbs into and switch on the study-desk and guest-nightstand table lamps, leave the toolbox closed and the wooden utility tray parked, and finish empty-handed.
public_context: Balance the two closed storage cabinets in the north guest bedroom (one against the east wall and one against the west wall) using the supply stock on the south utility-room counter so that each of the two guest-bedroom cabinets holds one bottle of water, one bottle of apple juice, and one box of crackers with no extra supply items placed inside either cabinet, leave all remaining unused supply items resting on top of the south utility-room counter, and leave both guest-bedroom cabinet doors closed.

Place both paperback books from the east-hallway wooden workbench onto the floating wall shelf outside the study doorway, retrieve the two light bulbs from inside the metal toolbox on that hallway workbench, attach one light bulb to the unlit table lamp on the study desk and switch that lamp on, attach the other light bulb to the unlit table lamp on the guest-bedroom nightstand and switch that lamp on, and leave the metal toolbox closed on the hallway workbench. Rule: the metal toolbox must not be opened while either paperback book is still on the hallway workbench or on top of the toolbox.
Leave the wooden utility tray resting on either the south utility-room counter or the wooden side table along the west wall of the north guest bedroom, and finish with no object held.
